title: Woman Says It’s Too Late To Pull Her Over
description:
On July 17, 2020, La Crosse Police stopped a Dodge Neon for traveling 38 mph in a 25 mph zone. The occupants of the vehicle said there were no lights or sirens and it was too late to be pulled over.
